messages:
maria-finance: Heads up — found a negative hosted usage line on ACME's March invoice (987654) for -$120,000. Looks like retro credits from the Growth Promo Q1 experiment. Need revenue treatment guidance for month-end close (contra revenue vs deferral vs period reallocation). cc @adele-accounting @sara-controller
ben-ops: Checking. Link: https://billing.internal/acme/invoice/987654. Backfill applied 2026-03-20, tagged growth_promo_q1_2026; targeted usage from 2026-01-10 through 2026-03-15.
ben-ops: Invoice export snippet:```
customer,period,product,amount,tag
ACME,2026-01,hosted_usage,40000,growth_promo_q1_2026
ACME,2026-02,hosted_usage,30000,growth_promo_q1_2026
ACME,2026-03,hosted_usage,50000,growth_promo_q1_2026
```
adele-accounting: Key Q — was this issued as a credit memo (reduces AR) or negative invoice lines? If credit memo, reduce AR/revenue in orig period. If negative invoice line created now, may be current period adjustment unless we reclass.
tim-qa: The backfill job (backfill-20260320-77a) created negative invoice lines rather than separate credit memos — ops decision to simplify billing.
sara-controller: Preferred: map credits to original recognition months and post period-of-origin reversals where possible. If mapping not possible, record as current period revenue adjustment and disclose. Anything > $50k needs CFO signoff.
revenue-bot: Automation estimate by orig_period: ["2026-01": "-40000", "2026-02": "-30000", "2026-03": "-50000"]. Suggested path: (1) Reverse original revenue where tie-out exists (GL 4099) (2) If tie-out fails, post catch-up in 2026-03 to 'Revenue Adjustments' and memo.
maria-finance: Adele — confirm GL and approval thresholds. Close timetable: books lock 04/05. I can prepare a period split CSV by EOD.
adele-accounting: Use GL 4099 'Revenue Adjustments (contra)'. I can approve adjustments up to $50k; >$50k requires CFO email to finance-cfo. Post reversing JV to original period if invoice doc IDs available; otherwise post to 2026-03 with disclosure.
ben-ops: I'll export the invoice lineage + runbook and attach evidence (invoice IDs, runbook, job id).
maria-finance: Action items: (1) I'll produce period-by-period tie-out CSV + memo due EOD. (2) Ben will attach invoice lineage & runbook. (3) Adele to confirm GL and approve up to $50k. (4) Sara to draft disclosure for close pack and queue CFO if needed.
sara-controller: Drafting disclosure. Flag me if customer disputes expected.
maria-finance: Q: treat cash refunds vs credit memos differently for R-rec?
adele-accounting: Yes — cash refunds reduce cash/AR and need tax analysis; include refund vs credit memo splits in memo.
maria-finance: Will post CSV and supporting docs here when ready. :white_check_mark:
